about_the_game:
A set consisting of the 3 scenarios that won the Fictional Scenario Contest held for Japan, Asia, and Europe/America, titled "The Tiger and the Soaring General Go to Zhongyuan", "Romance of the Four Kingdoms" and "The Three Kingdoms in Thirds" along with the CG portraits of the 10 most popular "ROMANCE OF THE THREE KINGDOMS 12" officers as decided in the "ROMANCE OF THE THREE KINGDOMS" Day survey.

Three additional scenarios
- The Tiger and the Soaring General Go to Zhongyuan
- Romance of the Four Kingdoms
- The Three Kingdoms in Thirds

Additional CG portraits
A total of 10 CG portraits of "ROMANCE OF THE THREE KINGDOMS 12" officers such as Zhao Yun and Zhuge Liang.

How to access:
・ Additional scenarios
Select New Game and then Scenarios, where you can choose "The Tiger and the Soaring General Go to Zhongyuan", "Romance of the Four Kingdoms" or "The Three Kingdoms in Thirds" to begin playing.

・ Additional CG portraits
Set officers' CG portraits via Edit Original Officers or Edit Historical Officers.
To view the portraits, select Edit, Edit Original Officers, Create Original Officers or Change Original Officers, and then Portrait. Alternatively, select Edit, Edit Historical Officers, Edit Historical Officers again, Portrait, and then the "Special" tab.
